Plataformas de venda

4 endpoints da API REST v1.

Todos os endpoints usam a chave no cabeçalho X-Api-Key. Veja Autenticação.

  • postCreate a sales platform

List sales platforms#

get/v1/projects/{id}/sales-platforms

List project sales platforms, including the connected Nuvemshop store identifier when present. Required permission: sales-platform.list.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 20

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/sales-platforms" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Create a sales platform#

post/v1/projects/{id}/sales-platforms

Create a sales platform with a generated webhook code. Required permission: sales-platform.create.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

typestringobrigatório

Valores: hotmart, hotmart_v2, kiwify, monetizze, eduzz, braip, perfectpay, yampi, cartpanda, stripe, payt, pagueio, buygoods, digistore24, digipag, shopify, upag, kirvano, actionpay, atomopay, tribopay, proofpay, paradise, goatpay, inovapag, lunacheckout, vegacheckout, appmax, zedy, amplopay, lastlink, mundpay, ticto, nuvemshop, generic

paramsTemplateobject[]

Params added to the checkout URL when a visitor goes through an offer. Sales are attributed by the {request.id} macro, so include it in the param the platform returns in its webhook (see the playbook for each platform).

Padrão: []

keystring

Query param name added to the checkout URL. Entries with an empty key are skipped.

Padrão: ""

valuestring

Text with {request.<field>} macros; fields: utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmTerm, utmContent, clickId, trafficSource, sub1, sub2, sub3, sub4, sub5, sub6, sub7, sub8, adPlatform, adAccountId, campaignId, adsetId, adId, visitorId, country, city, state, browser, os, device, browserLanguage, host, path, id, linkId. Any other macro resolves to empty, and an entry whose value resolves to empty is not added.

Padrão: ""

Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/sales-platforms" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "type": "hotmart",
  "paramsTemplate": []
}'
Respostas
201object

Created successfully.

Delete a sales platform#

delete/v1/projects/{id}/sales-platforms/{salesPlatformId}

Soft-delete an unused sales platform. A conflict includes links that still reference it. Required permission: sales-platform.delete.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
salesPlatformIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
Exemplo
curl -X DELETE "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/sales-platforms/{salesPlatformId}" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

successbooleanobrigatório
401object

The X-Api-Key header is missing or the API key is invalid.

403object

The key is expired, revoked, lacks permission, or its creator no longer has the required team access. A conflicting X-Team-Id is also rejected.

404object

The requested resource was not found or is outside the permitted scope.

409object

The sales platform is still used by links. The links array identifies those references.

422object

Invalid input. Each field path maps to its first validation message; _form identifies an object-level error.

An unexpected error occurred.
